exposure: cord care practices (methylated spirit, chlorhexidine, dry cord care)
source of cord care recommendations (health worker vs. non-health worker)
cohort: The study included 453 caregivers visiting two referral facilities in the Ashanti region, Ghana, with babies aged 1 week to 1 year.
finding: Cord outcomes differed with various cord care practices, with antenatal care attendance and handwashing before cord care associated with reduced odds of cord infection, and non-health worker recommendations linked to increased odds of cord bleeding.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from June to December 2023, regarding cord care practices and outcomes for babies aged 1 week to 1 year.
